title: ModTheSpire2
description:
ModTheSpire2 is a pre-launch mod selector and restart helper for Slay the Spire 2.

GitHub:
https://github.com/grassdog0/MTS2

Main features:
- Windows launcher with no extra runtime install.
- Choose vanilla, selected mods, load order, and named profiles before the game starts.
- The launcher reads the current settings.save order and enabled state.
- Dependency-aware mod list with compatibility for common Workshop manifest layouts.
- Read-only Better Mod Menu grouping import when available.
- The in-game Launcher button is placed beside Installed Mods, reuses the native Get Mods button appearance, and follows the game's typography and scaling.
- The management dialog has clearer native-style text, readable game-scaled typography, scrolling, reliable close/cancel controls, and launch-option text selection.
- Close and Open Launcher forwards renderer flags such as --rendering-driver opengl3.

Windows Steam launch option:
\"<path to ModTheSpire2Launcher.exe>\" -- %command%
Keep %command% exactly as written. Add extra game arguments after %command%.

Experimental cross-platform preview:
- ModTheSpire2Launcher.sh for native Linux / Steam Deck.
- ModTheSpire2Launcher.command for native macOS Steam.
- These are lightweight script-menu previews, not full GUI launchers. Linux/macOS support has not been verified on real systems yet. Volunteers and feedback are welcome.

Workshop cannot edit Steam launch options automatically. The multiplayer helper does not bypass mismatch checks, force joins, or auto-subscribe Workshop items.
changeNote:
